name: SimplyCams
description:
كاميرات منزلك على جهاز Enigma2

SimplyCams يعرض كاميرات IP وأجهزة DVR في شبكتك على جهاز الاستقبال Vu+ أو أي جهاز Enigma2 آخر، بشكل شبكة كاميرات تشبه أجهزة التسجيل الأمنية. من تطوير reali22.
author: reali22

changelog.text: 1.0 - Camera grid of 4 or 9, single camera or list. The selected camera plays live; the other tiles show pictures that refresh automatically. Full-screen view with a thin info bar. Messages appear as a thin bar, so they never cover the picture. PTZ on the arrow keys. On cameras that pan and tilt, the arrow keys move the camera directly. ⏪/⏩ zoom, and MENU saves and recalls 9 positions. Snapshots saved to your disk or USB stick. Network search and Auto-fill. en.description:
SimplyCams 1.0 – watch your home cameras on your Enigma2 receiver

SimplyCams shows your IP cameras and DVRs on your Vu+ or other Enigma2 receiver, in a camera grid like a security recorder. Plugin by reali22.

🔗 https://github.com/Ahmed-Mohammed-Abbas/SimplyCams
